# Dissident Voice

> > Independent media platform providing progressive political analysis, anti-war commentary, and critical perspectives on US foreign policy, Middle East geopolitics, and global imperialism.

Dissident Voice is an independent news and political analysis website based in Santa Rosa, California, featuring commentary from journalists and analysts on international conflicts, US military intervention, and progressive social justice issues. The site welcomes submissions from contributors and relies on reader donations to support its independent journalism.

## Key Topics

- Middle East geopolitics
- Iran-US conflict
- Israel-Palestine
- US foreign policy
- Military intervention
- Trump administration
- BDS movement
- War crimes
- Sanctions policy
- Indigenous rights
- Anti-war commentary
- International law
- Independent media
- Political commentary
- Geopolitical analysis

## Core Pages

- [Dissident Voice Homepage](https://dissidentvoice.org): Homepage featuring independent news, political analysis, and progressive commentary on global issues.
- [About Dissident Voice](https://dissidentvoice.org/about): About page describing Dissident Voice's mission, editorial team, and commitment to independent media.
- [Dissident Voice Books](https://dissidentvoice.org/books): Curated book recommendations on politics, social justice, and critical global analysis.
- [Dissident Voice Links](https://dissidentvoice.org/links): Curated links to independent media, progressive resources, and alternative news websites.

## Middle East & Iran Conflict

- [US-Israel War against Iran Require a War Crimes Commission](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/us-israel-war-against-iran-require-a-war-crimes-commission): Renee Parsons analysis of US-Israel military intervention, Iran conflict, and war crimes.
- [Middle East Danger Zones: A 2026 Update](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/middle-east-danger-zones-a-2026-update): Bichler & Nitzan analysis of Middle East conflicts, oil politics, and geopolitical tensions.
- [No Naval Escort for Trump: US Allies and the Strait of Hormuz](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/no-naval-escort-for-trump-us-allies-and-the-strait-of-hormuz): Binoy Kampmark analysis of Trump administration, Iran conflict, and Middle East geopolitics.
- [Iran's Arrows and the West's Achilles' Heel](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/irans-arrows-and-the-wests-achilles-heel): Strategic analysis of Iran-US conflict, military capability, and Middle East geopolitics.
- [Why the 2026 Middle East Crisis Demands Critical AI Literacy](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/why-the-2026-middle-east-crisis-demands-critical-ai-literacy): Nolan Higdon article on AI literacy, deepfakes, and misinformation in Middle East coverage.

## US Foreign Policy & War Accountability

- [The Warmongers Will Never Admit They Were Wrong And Will Never Learn From Their Mistakes](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/the-warmongers-will-never-admit-they-were-wrong-and-will-never-learn-from-their-mistakes): Caitlin Johnstone commentary on John Bolton, Trump, and US foreign policy accountability.
- [What Mearsheimer Gets Right — and Wrong — About 38 Million Sanctions Deaths](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/what-mearsheimer-gets-right-and-wrong-about-38-million-sanctions-deaths): Jan Oberg critique of US sanctions policy, mortality data, and international relations.
- [The U.S. Bombs Kids So Palmer Luckey Can Have Nice Things](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/the-u-s-bombs-kids-so-palmer-luckey-can-have-nice-things): Ethan Thornton critique of Palmer Luckey, Anduril, and military-industrial profiteering.

## Palestine, BDS & Anti-Imperialism

- [Left response to antisemitism should be to call for BDS](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/left-response-to-antisemitism-should-be-to-call-for-bds): Gary Engler article on BDS movement, Israel-Palestine conflict, and anti-apartheid activism.
- [When Opposition Calls for "Free" and "Fair" Elections to Guarantee "Democracy" in Venezuela, What Do They Mean?](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/when-opposition-calls-for-free-and-fair-elections-to-guarantee-democracy-in-venezuela-what-do-they-mean): Yader Lanuza critique of US imperialism, Venezuelan opposition, and Bolivarian Revolution.

## Global Justice & Indigenous Rights

- [Tanzania: Commissions Call for Mass Eviction of Indigenous Maasai from World-famous Tourist Destinations](https://dissidentvoice.org/2026/03/tanzania-commissions-call-for-mass-eviction-of-indigenous-maasai-from-world-famous-tourist-destinations): Analysis of Maasai land eviction in Tanzania, conservation conflicts, and indigenous rights.
